blocks.text: Physics ki measurements mein precision aur accuracy ke words aksar aate hain, aur in dono ka farq saaf samajhna zaroori hai. Measurement ki precision (kitni baareeki se naapa) us instrument se tay hoti hai jis se measurement ki gayi: least count jitna chhota, measurement utni precise. Accuracy ka matlab hai measurement kisi quantity ki exact (asal) ya accepted (maani hui) value ke kitni qareeb hai. Yeh fractional ya percentage uncertainty se show hoti hai: fractional ya percentage uncertainty jitni kam, measurement utni accurate.

• Precision: absolute uncertainty kam.
• Accuracy: percentage uncertainty kam.
blocks.title: Remember Thumb Rule (yaad rakhne ka aasan rule)

blocks.text: Example: ek cheez ki length millimetre wale metre rule se 25.5 cm napi gayi. Is ki precision ya absolute uncertainty (least count) = ± 0.1 cm hai.
Ek aur measurement 0.01 cm least count wale Vernier Callipers se li gayi aur 0.45 cm aayi. Is ki precision ya absolute uncertainty = ± 0.01 cm hai.

Kitab yahan numerator (fraction ke upar wala hissa) mein 0.1 cm chhapti hai. Vernier Callipers ki absolute uncertainty 0.01 cm hai, is liye sahi calculation 0.01 / 0.45 ≈ 0.02 aur 2% hai; kitab ke answers (0.02 aur 2%) bhi isi ke mutabiq hain.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Yun metre rule ki reading 25.5 cm kam precise hai magar zyada accurate hai, kyunke us ki percentage uncertainty (error) kam hai.

Jabke Vernier Callipers ki reading 0.45 cm zyada precise hai magar kam accurate. Asal baat relative (doosri cheez ke muqable mein) measurement ki hai: quantity jitni chhoti ho, utna zyada precise instrument istemal karna chahiye. Yahan 0.45 cm napne ke liye aur zyada precise instrument, jaise 0.001 cm least count wala micrometer screw gauge, istemal hona chahiye tha. Is se yeh conclusion (nateeja) nikalta hai:
Precise measurement woh hai jis ki absolute uncertainty kam ho, aur accurate measurement woh hai jis ki fractional ya percentage uncertainty kam ho.
blocks.title: Precise aur accurate measurement

blocks.text: Hum kabhi bhi bilkul exact measurement nahi kar sakte. Zyada se zyada yeh kar sakte hain ke instrument ki limit ke andar asal value ke jitna ho sake qareeb pohanchein.
Hum length, time aur temperature jaisi quantities napne ke liye bohat se devices (aalaat) istemal karte hain. Har ek ki precision ki koi limit hoti hai.
blocks.title: For your information

blocks.text: Yeh sajawat (decoration) ke sheeshe nahi balke sab se purane maloom exquisite (bohat khoobsurat) aur sensitive (zara si tabdeeli bhi pakarne wale) thermometers hain, jo Florence mein Accademia del Cimento (1657-1667) ne banaye. In mein alcohol bhara hota tha, jise kabhi kabhi aasani se parhne ke liye laal rang diya jata tha.
blocks.title: For your information

blocks.prompt: Ek student ek moti taar ka diameter metre rule se 3 mm aur mez ki length 1 mm least count wale tape se 1.253 m napta hai. Kaun si measurement zyada precise hai, kaun si zyada accurate, aur student ko kya badalna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Dono instruments ka least count 1 mm hai, is liye dono readings barabar precise hain. Taar ki percentage uncertainty (1 mm / 3 mm) × 100 ≈ 33% hai, jabke mez ki (1 mm / 1253 mm) × 100 ≈ 0.08%; is liye mez ki length kahin zyada accurate hai. Chhota diameter zyada precise instrument, jaise micrometer screw gauge (least count 0.01 mm), se napna chahiye.

items: Precision instrument ke least count (absolute uncertainty) se tay hoti hai; accuracy fractional ya percentage uncertainty se.
Metre rule se 25.5 cm: 0.4%, kam precise magar zyada accurate. Vernier Callipers se 0.45 cm: 2%, zyada precise magar kam accurate.
Chhoti quantity ke liye zyada precise instrument chahiye (screw gauge, 0.001 cm). Koi measurement bilkul exact nahi hoti.
